verdict: Moosend: Choose Moosend when budget email automation with unlimited sends on Pro is the priority. Scores use the email-marketing editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Unlimited sends on Pro research packaging
Automation and landing pages included on Pro
weaknesses: Live calculator required for exact tiers
Lower brand recognition than Mailchimp/Constant Contact
Not a sales CRM of record
bestFor: SMBs wanting automation with budget contact-tier pricing
Teams that send frequently and want unlimited sends on Pro
notIdealFor: Buyers who need a forever-free ESP to start
Ecommerce brands needing Klaviyo-depth catalog SMS
tradeoffs: Forever-free / trial entry vs paid feature unlocks
Core ESP breadth vs adjacent deliverability/verification specialization
recommendation: Choose Moosend when budget email automation with unlimited sends on Pro is the priority. Compare Brevo for send-based free/paid value, GetResponse for all-in-one free-tier paths, ActiveCampaign for deeper automation+CRM, and MailerLite for free-tier ease.
